no_adcom_quote.quote: No Oncology Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) Meeting or other external consultations are required for the current application.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the INQOVI (decitabine and cedazuridine) NDA212576 application. The FDA Multidisciplinary Review's Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states that no ODAC meeting or other external consultations were required. Consequently, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
